selection: All notice-bearing C/C++ comments in llvm/include, llvm/lib, clang/include, clang/lib, clang/tools files with .h/.hpp/.c/.cpp/.cc/.inc/.def/.td/.S/.s suffixes. Separate named LICENSE texts are covered by llvm-archive-review.json.
limitations: Superset of candidate notices; individual static objects are not proven to originate from these source bytes merely by this scan.
Not an exhaustive scanner for non-comment notices or source languages outside the declared selection.
